content.comment_body: Hello, We have two similar systems operating with two [product_name] PLCs. Both have identical programs and are equipped with memory cards. Unfortunately, the program on one [product_name] PLC was erased. What is the best way to transfer the program from the other [product_name] PLC to the affected one, while ensuring the operational PLC continues running without disruption? If I remove the memory card from the system that is currently in operation, will it impact its functionality? Thank you. Regards, [user_name]

You can upload the program from the working PLC and then download it to the erased PLC, provided they are compatible. Do you have a backup of the program? If not, you could reach out to the programmer for one. There are multiple possible solutions.
Hello, It is possible to use the memory card to transfer the program. You may want to refer to the user's guide, specifically in chapter 6, for detailed instructions.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are addressing program transfer between two identical [product_name] PLCs following accidental data loss. The priority is to perform this transfer without interfering with the operation of the functional PLC, particularly concerning memory card removal. There is also a noted gap in program backup procedures, with users exploring safe, non-invasive ways to transfer programs. This highlights a need for clear processes and documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user aims to move the program from a functioning [product_name] PLC to a second unit without disrupting the live system, looking for a risk-free and simple solution.
